items.informal_name: Submultiplicative Norm Inequality for Finite Products in Normed Commutative Rings
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : Type u_5} [inst : NormedCommRing α] [NormOneClass α] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α),
  ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖₊ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖₊
items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ and function $ f : \iota \to \alpha $ where $ \alpha $ is a normed commutative ring with $ \|1\| = 1 $, the non-negative norm of the product $ \prod_{i \in s} f(i) $ is less than or equal to the product of the non-negative norms $ \prod_{i \in s} \|f(i)\|_+ $. Formally, $ \left\| \prod_{i \in s} f(i) \right\|_+ \leq \prod_{i \in s} \|f(i)\|_+ $.

items.informal_name: Norm Inequality for Finite Products in Normed Commutative Rings
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : Type u_5} [inst : NormedCommRing α] (s : Finset ι),
  s.Nonempty → ∀ (f : ι → α), ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖₊ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖₊
items.informal_description: In a normed commutative ring $\alpha$, for any non-empty finite set $s$ and function $f : \iota \to \alpha$, the norm of the product of $f(i)$ over $s$ is less than or equal to the product of the norms of $f(i)$ over $s$. Formally, $\left\| \prod_{i \in s} f(i) \right\|_+ \leq \prod_{i \in s} \|f(i)\|_+$, where $\|\cdot\|_+$ denotes the non-negative real norm.

items.informal_name: Norm of Product ≤ Product of Norms in Normed Commutative Ring
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : Type u_5} [inst : NormedCommRing α] (s : Finset ι),
  s.Nonempty → ∀ (f : ι → α), ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖
items.informal_description: For any non-empty finite set $ s $ of indices and any function $ f $ mapping $ s $ to a normed commutative ring $ \alpha $, the norm of the product of the elements $ f(i) $ for $ i \in s $ is less than or equal to the product of the norms of each $ f(i) $. Formally, $ \left\| \prod_{i \in s} f(i) \right\| \leq \prod_{i \in s} \|f(i)\| $.

items.informal_name: Norm Inequality for Product Over Finite Set in Normed Commutative Ring with NormOneClass
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : Type u_5} [inst : NormedCommRing α] [NormOneClass α] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α),
  ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖
items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ and function $ f $ mapping elements of $ s $ to a normed commutative ring $ \alpha $ with the norm of the multiplicative identity equal to one, the norm of the product of $ f(i) $ over $ s $ is less than or equal to the product of the norms of each $ f(i) $. Formally, $ \left\|\prod_{i \in s} f(i)\right\| \leq \prod_{i \in s} \|f(i)\| $.

items.informal_name: Extended Norm Inequality for Finite Products
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {ε : Type u_8} [inst : TopologicalSpace ε] [inst_1 : ESeminormedCommMonoid ε] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → ε), ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖ₑ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ₑ
items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of indices $ \iota $ and any function $ f : \iota \to \varepsilon $ in a seminormed commutative monoid $ \varepsilon $ equipped with a topology, the extended norm of the product of $ f(i) $ over $ s $ is less than or equal to the sum of the extended norms of each $ f(i) $. Symbolically, $ \left\| \prod_{i \in s} f(i) \right\|_e \leq \sum_{i \in s} \| f(i) \|_e $, where $ \|\cdot\|_e $ denotes the extended norm.

items.informal_name: Non-Negative Norm of List Product is Submultiplicative
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : SeminormedRing α] [NormOneClass α] (l : List α), ‖l.prod‖₊ ≤ (List.map nnnorm l).prod
items.informal_description: For any list $ l $ of elements in a seminormed ring $ \alpha $ with a norm-one class, the non-negative norm of the product of the elements in $ l $ is less than or equal to the product of the non-negative norms of the individual elements in $ l $. Formally, $ \|l.prod\|_+ \leq \prod_{x \in l} \|x\|_+ $.

items.informal_name: Norm of Product Inequality in Seminormed Commutative Groups
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E),
  ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖
items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of elements of type $ \iota $ and any function $ f : \iota \to E $ where $ E $ is a seminormed commutative group, the seminorm of the product of $ f(i) $ over $ s $ is less than or equal to the sum of the seminorms of $ f(i) $ over $ s $. Symbolically, $ \left\| \prod_{i \in s} f(i) \right\| \leq \sum_{i \in s} \|f(i)\| $.

items.informal_name: Norm of Product is Bounded by Sum of Norm Bounds in a Seminormed Commutative Group
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → E} {n : ι → ℝ},
  (∀ b ∈ s, ‖f b‖ ≤ n b) → ‖∏ b ∈ s, f b‖ ≤ ∑ b ∈ s, n b
items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of elements of type $ \iota $, functions $ f : \iota \to E $ and $ n : \iota \to \mathbb{R} $, if for every $ b \in s $, the norm of $ f(b) $ satisfies $ \|f(b)\| \leq n(b) $, then the norm of the product of $ f(b) $ over all $ b \in s $ is less than or equal to the sum of $ n(b) $ over $ s $. Formally, $ \left\| \prod_{b \in s} f(b) \right\| \leq \sum_{b \in s} n(b) $.
